articles.title: North Korean fake recruiters infect 30K devices, steal $10.7M in crypto
articles.snippet: North Korean cyber group WaterPlum targeted developers with fake jobs at crypto, AI and NFT companies, infecting at least 30,000 devices across more than 100 countries.

articles.title: Sony Says You Don't Own the Games You Bought. Crypto Says It Can Fix That
articles.snippet: Crypto advocates argue that NFTs can deliver real digital ownership, but privacy gaps and integration hurdles have held the tech back.
